workarounds.symptom: Placed assets: material overrides cannot take a snippet, and post-pass objects need one entry per GLB part
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Let a post pass name a placed asset by its node id (#3055). Target files: src/post-mask.js, src/user-pass.js, tests/post-steps.test.js. A part name still wins when it matches. Because a 13-part asset would have hit the 16 ID cap, one pass may now hold up to 64 resolved parts (the list is still at most 16 names). workarounds.symptom: Asset catalog cap of 64 counts unreferenced files in --assets
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Index up to 256 catalog files and name the counted files in limit errors (#2989). Target files: src/agent-asset-limits.js, src/agent-scene-assets.js, scripts/agent-asset-catalog.mjs. The `--assets` catalog refused a folder with more than 64 GLB, BVH, HDR or CUBE files even when the recipe placed one. The catalog cap is now 256 (still a hard bound, enforced at startup). (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/3076)

workarounds.symptom: Motion keyframe at the clip end is refused when float sums overshoot the duration by a rounding error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Snap motion keyframe times a rounding error past the clip end (#3033). Target files: src/agent-motion.js, src/motion-validation.js, tests/agent-motion.test.js. Keyframes built by adding a step (`time += 0.1`) land at 1.5000000000000002 for a 1.5 s clip, and `scene_create` refused the whole recipe. Motion and IK keyframe times within a relative 1e-9 of 0 or the duration now snap to that end. A time clearly outside is still refused with the same message. (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/3035)

workarounds.symptom: WebCodecs video render collapses every frame after the 2 s keyframe into one instant
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Give the in-page encoder's H.264 explicit frame times so long clips keep their length (#2759). Target files: scripts/frame-encoder.mjs, tests/fixtures/page-encoder-72-frames-24fps.h264, tests/render-media-audio-and-stills.test.js. The in-page WebCodecs encoder writes raw H.264 with no timing data, and ffmpeg guessed the frame times when copying it into the MP4. From the 51st frame on it gave every frame a 1 microsecond length, so a 4 s clip came out 2.08 s. The copy path now sets frame N to N / fps with the `setts` bitstre... (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/2785)

workarounds.symptom: scene_create throws "Map maximum size exceeded" for a ground plus 2,400 instanced copies
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep the coplanar search bounded for large grounds with many copies (#2302). Target files: src/flush-search.js, tests/flush-search-grid-limit.test.js, changes/2302.md. The coplanar search sizes its reach from the scene diagonal, so a 160 m ground grew the reach and every small triangle's box. Two million triangles then listed over 16 million native cell entries in one Map, past V8's 2^24 limit. workarounds.symptom: scene_render_status of a finished job fails while a newer job runs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Let scene_render_status answer for a finished job while a newer job runs (#1927). Target files: scripts/agent-runtime.mjs, tests/agent-runtime.test.js, changes/1927.md. `jobStatus` called `requirePreviewRenderer`, which throws when any job is active, for every terminal record it returned. Asking for a finished job while a newer one ran failed with "The renderer is leased". It now only hands the renderer back when no job is active and always returns the record. (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/1930)
